headline:
Rockdale Now Allows
Smaller Homes On Eligible Lots
turn_1: Echo, Rockdale County's new development code took effect October 1. Owners on eligible lots can add a smaller second home.
turn_2: A second home on the same lot? What does that open up?
turn_3: Think guest cottage or in-law suite on the same lot as the main house. The code also sets standards for tiny home and cottage home villages.
echo_line: So a parent could move in next door, and a buyer gets one more kind of home to look at. I only need a lot first.
source: Rockdale County news release · rockdalecountyga.gov · posted October 26, 2026
disclaimer: General information about a county rule. Check the county's code and its Planning and Development Department for what applies to a specific lot.
